name: Planning-Only Verification Route
description: Run verify-plan against declared adapter manifests, policy and observations; it records priority, explicit selection, fallback denial and version-exclusion decisions only, without spawning, dispatching or accepting an adapter.

harness_contract.intent: Plan adapter selection from host-declared documents only. Explicit selection, denied fallback, version pins and permission exclusions are planning decisions. No adapter is spawned, dispatched or accepted, and the selected adapter is not a verification result.
artifact_contracts: Read the request, policy, adapter manifests and host-declared observations under scenarios/verify_plan/src/.

The priority plan selects beta by declared priority; explicit lower-priority alpha selection records selected_explicit; beta-unavailable fallback selects alpha only when policy permits fallback; denied fallback selects nothing; a pinned tool-version mismatch excludes beta.
A gamma adapter requiring network.connect is excluded by the policy that allows only process.spawn, with its tested exclusion reason.
A request with an unsupported profile emits a plan whose selected field is null; the planning command exits 0.
Input fixture hashes match before and after planning. Plans contain no injected environment sentinel or adapter execution, dispatch or acceptance record.
notes: PLANNING-ONLY: adapter selection is planning metadata, not a verification result.
Availability and tool versions are host-declared observations; this route does not probe or invoke adapters.
The permission-exclusion case uses network.connect against the declared process.spawn-only policy.
The unsupported-profile case has no compatible adapter and is reported with selected: null.

steps.name: Snapshot declared planner input bytes
steps.artifact_contract: Record SHA-256 hashes for every source fixture used by the four plans.
steps.verifier_gate: The final integrity step must reproduce this exact hash listing.

steps.name: Plan: select the highest-priority compatible adapter
steps.command:
MUMEI_TEST_SECRET=FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json --output {output_dir}/plan_priority.json > {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
d=json.load(open(p))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
selected=(d.get("selected") or {}).get("adapter_id")
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and selected == "beta" and d.get("fallback_from") is None and reasons.get("beta") == ["selected_priority"] and reasons.get("alpha") == ["compatible_not_selected"] and not any(k in d for k in ("candidate","acceptance","dispatch","selected_result","accepted")) and "FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d" not in open(p).read())
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("priority selection mismatch")
print("priority selection only; injected environment sentinel absent")' {output_dir}/plan_priority.json
expected_patterns: priority selection only; injected environment sentinel absent
steps.artifact_contract: plan_priority.json uses mumei.verification-plan/v1, selects beta, records the exact tested decision reasons and has no fallback origin or execution record.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and its output omits the injected environment sentinel.

steps.name: Plan: fall back when beta is unavailable
steps.command:
{mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_fallback.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_beta_missing.json --output {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json > {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
selected=(d.get("selected") or {}).get("adapter_id")
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and selected == "alpha" and d.get("fallback_from") == "beta" and reasons.get("alpha") == ["selected_fallback"] and "tool_missing" in reasons.get("beta",[]))
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("fallback selection mismatch")
print("beta unavailable; alpha selected with beta fallback origin")' {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json
steps.artifact_contract: With beta's host-declared availability set to missing, the plan selects alpha and records fallback_from as beta.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and the plan retains the unavailable requested adapter as fallback origin.

steps.name: Plan: explicit selection does not fall back
steps.command:
MUMEI_TEST_SECRET=FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_explicit.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json --output {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.json > {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
selected=(d.get("selected") or {}).get("adapter_id")
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and selected == "alpha" and d.get("fallback_from") is None and reasons.get("alpha") == ["selected_explicit"] and reasons.get("beta") == ["compatible_not_selected"])
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("explicit selection mismatch")
print("explicit alpha selected; no fallback")' {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.json
steps.artifact_contract: plan_explicit_selection.json selects lower-priority alpha through explicit host policy, records selected_explicit, and has no fallback origin or execution record.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and explicit selection is represented as planning metadata only.

steps.name: Plan: denied fallback selects nothing
steps.command:
MUMEI_TEST_SECRET=FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_explicit.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_alpha_missing.json --output {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.json > {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and d.get("selected") is None and d.get("fallback_from") is None and "tool_missing" in reasons.get("alpha",[]) and reasons.get("beta") == ["explicit_selection_blocks_automatic_route"])
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("denied fallback mismatch")
print("fallback denied; no adapter selected")' {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.json
steps.artifact_contract: plan_denied_fallback.json keeps selected null when the explicit alpha is missing and fallback is denied; beta records explicit_selection_blocks_automatic_route.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 with an ordinary plan document and does not silently fall back.

steps.name: Plan: pinned tool version mismatch excludes beta
steps.command:

d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
selected=(d.get("selected") or {}).get("adapter_id")
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and selected == "alpha" and d.get("fallback_from") is None and reasons.get("beta") == ["tool_version_mismatch"] and reasons.get("alpha") == ["selected_priority"])
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("tool version mismatch")
print("tool version mismatch excludes beta")' {output_dir}/plan_tool_version_mismatch.json
steps.artifact_contract: plan_tool_version_mismatch.json excludes beta with tool_version_mismatch when the pinned version differs from the host-declared observation, while alpha remains the priority selection.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and a version mismatch is an exclusion reason, not an execution or acceptance result.

steps.name: Plan: exclude an adapter outside the permission policy
steps.command:
{mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters_permissions.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_permissions.json --output {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json > {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"])
selected=(d.get("selected") or {}).get("adapter_id")
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and selected == "beta" and reasons.get("gamma") == ["permissions_not_allowed"])
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("permission exclusion mismatch")
print("gamma excluded: permissions_not_allowed")' {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json
steps.artifact_contract: The permission-specific plan excludes gamma, whose declared network.connect requirement is outside policy.allowed_permissions.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and reports the tested permissions_not_allowed decision reason.

steps.name: Plan: report no compatible adapter
steps.command:
{mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request_no_compatible.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json --output {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json > {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
ok=(d.get("schema_version") == "mumei.verification-plan/v1" and d.get("selected") is None and d.get("fallback_from") is None and all("unsupported_semantic_profile" in x["reasons"] for x in d["decisions"]))
if not ok:
    raise SystemExit("no-compatible plan mismatch")
print("no compatible adapter; selected is null")' {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json
expected_patterns: no compatible adapter; selected is null
steps.artifact_contract: An unsupported request profile returns an ordinary plan document with selected: null and exit status 0.
steps.verifier_gate: The scenario pins selected: null rather than inventing a nonzero-exit contract.

steps.name: Check input integrity and planning-only output
steps.command:
before=$(cat {output_dir}/input_hashes.before); after=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_fallback.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_beta_missing.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters_permissions.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_permissions.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request_no_compatible.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_explicit.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_version_pin.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_beta_version_mismatch.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_alpha_missing.json); test "$before" = "$after" && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys
sentinel="FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d"
execution=set(("candidate","acceptance","dispatch","selected_result","accepted"))
texts=[open(p).read() for p in sys.argv[1:]]
leaked=any(sentinel in text for text in texts)
executed=any(execution.intersection(json.loads(text).keys()) for p,text in zip(sys.argv[1:],texts) if p.endswith(".json"))
if leaked or executed:
    raise SystemExit("planning boundary scan mismatch")
print("input hashes unchanged; no secret/environment values or execution records")' {output_dir}/plan_priority.json {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.json {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stdout {output_dir}/plan_explicit_selection.stderr {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.json {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stdout {output_dir}/plan_denied_fallback.stderr {output_dir}/plan_tool_version_mismatch.json {output_dir}/plan_tool_version_mismatch.stdout {output_dir}/plan_tool_version_mismatch.stderr {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr
expected_patterns: no secret/environment values or execution records
steps.artifact_contract: All declared input fixture hashes remain unchanged; plan documents omit the injected environment sentinel and any execution or acceptance record.
steps.verifier_gate: Only planning outputs are present: the route never spawns or dispatches an adapter, accepts anything, or returns a verifier result.
